text: DSH Task Groups（DSH 网页客户端插件）：为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏补充任务分组和活动面板。它替换侧边栏工作区列表区域，提供自定义分组视图并保留按项目浏览的切换方式；用户可以拖动任务和分组调整顺序、把会话归入分组，并在活动面板集中查看运行中、待确认和未读会话。适合需要整理多个 DSH 会话并快速查看待处理活动的用户。分组与视图状态保存在本机 DSH 数据目录，不需要额外 API key 或外部服务。

DSH Task Groups adds custom conversation groups and an activity panel to the DSH web sidebar. Users can drag to reorder tasks, switch to project browsing, and use the bell to find running, pending, or unread conversations. State is stored locally; no API key is needed.
我想把不同主题的 DSH 会话分组整理，还能拖动调整顺序。
DSH 有没有地方能一眼看到正在运行、未读或等待确认的对话？
I want to sort my DSH conversations into custom groups and quickly spot active or unread ones.
DSH Task Groups 的功能「自定义任务分组」：在侧边栏创建并管理会话分组，通过拖动任务或分组调整顺序，也可将会话移入分组或移回未分组列表。分组状态保存在 DSH 本机数据目录。
DSH Task Groups 的功能「活动面板」：点击侧边栏铃铛查看运行中、等待确认和未读会话；面板把需关注的会话列在优先级区域，并提供清除已读操作。

dsh-task-groups README · 🗂️ 按自己的方式整理任务：- **自定义分组**：把相关会话放在一起，为分组命名、换色，随时折叠或展开。 - **拖拽整理**：调整任务和分组的顺序；拖进分组即可归类，拖到组外即可移出。分组也可以放在未分组任务之间。 - **组内操作**：直接新建任务，或批量标为已读、归档会话。 - **保留项目视图**：随时切回按工作区查看，继续使用「显示更多」展开任务列表。

text: dsh-task-groups README · 🔔 一眼找到需要关注的会话：点击侧边栏的小铃铛，打开「活动」面板。**运行中、等待确认和未读的会话**会集中在「优先级」，其余会话列在「其他」。 打开未读会话后，它仍会留在「优先级」，方便来回查看。处理完后，点击右上角的**扫帚（清除已读）**，将可清理的会话移入「其他」；运行中或等待确认的会话会继续保留。再次点击铃铛即可返回任务列表。

text:
dsh-task-groups README · 🚀 快速安装：需要已安装并运行过的 **DeepSeek Harness**，以及 **Git** 和 **Node.js 20.11+**。以下以 Windows 的默认 `desktop` profile 为例：

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/spike237/dsh-task-groups.git
cd dsh-task-groups
node tools/enable-profile.mjs
```

也可以直接从 npm 安装（需要 DSH 0.2.1+）：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-task-groups
```

**重启 DSH**，侧边栏出现「分组 / 项目」切换和小铃铛后即可使用。

> [!NOTE]
> 安装脚本会备份并修改已有的 profile 配置，将插件链接到当前仓库目录。安装后请保留这个目录；如果移动了目录，需要重新设置链接。

<details>
<summary>其他 profile、自定义路径与卸载</summary>

dsh-task-groups README · 🚀 快速安装：指定已有的 profile： ```powershell node tools/enable-profile.mjs --profile my-profile ``` 指定 DSH 数据目录（其中需已有对应的 `profiles//package.json`）： ```powershell node tools/enable-profile.mjs --home "D:\DSH" --profile desktop ``` 未传入 `--home` 时，脚本优先使用环境变量 `DSH_HOME`，否则使用 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh`。 卸载默认 profile 中的插件，然后重启 DSH： ```powershell node tools/enable-profile.mjs --remove ``` 如果安装时指定了 `--home` 或 `--profile`，卸载时使用相同参数。卸载会移除插件配置与目录链接，保留分组数据。

dsh-task-groups README · 🧭 使用指南：右键分组即可打开操作菜单，选择 **新建分组** 后，再把相关任务拖进去。

| 想做什么 | 怎么操作 |
| --- | --- |
| 新建分组 | 右键分组 → 新建分组，也可使用顶部 `⋯` 菜单 |
| 切换整理方式 | 点击顶部「分组 / 项目」 |
| 修改分组名称或颜色 | 点击分组前的彩色 `#` 图标 |
| 在组内新建任务 | 点击分组右侧的 `⊕` |
| 调整顺序或所属分组 | 拖动任务或分组，按插入线放置 |
| 查看当前活动 | 点击小铃铛；再次点击返回 |
| 清理活动列表 | 点击活动面板右上角的扫帚 |
| 搜索任务 | 顶部 `⋯` → 搜索任务 |
| 更多任务操作 | 右键任务，可重命名、置顶、标记未读、分支、移动到分组或归档 |

删除分组只会解除任务的分组关系，任务仍然保留。右键分组还可以编辑、全部标为已读或批量归档会话。

dsh-task-groups README · 🛠️ 开发与数据：分组、任务归属、排序和视图偏好保存在 `$DSH_HOME/task-groups/state.json`；未设置 `DSH_HOME` 时使用用户目录下的 `.dsh`。由 Host 校验并原子写入，重启后可恢复。

<details>
<summary>运行检查</summary>

Host 状态读写与校验：

```powershell
npm run smoke
```

界面渲染与交互检查需要一个已安装 `react`、`react-dom` 和 `jsdom` 的开发环境。将 `DSH_DEV_CHECKOUT` 指向该环境的 `package.json`：

```powershell
$env:DSH_DEV_CHECKOUT = "D:\path\to\dev-project\package.json"
npm test
```

覆盖分组、拖拽、项目视图、活动面板与菜单交互。

</details>

dsh-task-groups README · 🗂️ Organize tasks your way：- **Custom groups:** name, color, collapse and expand groups of related conversations.
- **Drag to organize:** reorder tasks and groups, move tasks into or out of a group, and place groups between ungrouped tasks.
- **Group actions:** start a task inside a group, mark its conversations as read, or archive them in bulk.
- **Project view:** switch back to workspace-based browsing, with “Show more” to expand the task list.

<details>
<summary>📁 See the project view</summary>

dsh-task-groups README · 🔔 Keep important activity in sight：Click the bell to open the activity panel. **Running conversations, pending confirmations and unread conversations** appear under “Priority” (优先级); the rest appear under “Others” (其他). Opening an unread conversation keeps it in the priority list so you can return to it. When you are done, click the **broom** to move eligible conversations to “Others”; running conversations and pending confirmations stay in place. Click the bell again to return to your task list.

dsh-task-groups README · 🚀 Install：You need an existing **DeepSeek Harness** installation that has been launched at least once, **Git**, and **Node.js 20.11+**. For the default `desktop` profile on Windows:

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/spike237/dsh-task-groups.git
cd dsh-task-groups
node tools/enable-profile.mjs
```

Or install from npm (requires DSH 0.2.1+):

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-task-groups
```

**Restart DSH.** The sidebar will show the “Groups / Projects” toggle and the bell.

dsh-task-groups README · 🚀 Install：> [!NOTE]
> The installer backs up and updates an existing profile configuration, then links the plugin to this checkout. Keep the repository directory in place; moving it requires updating the link.

<details>
<summary>Other profiles, custom paths and uninstalling</summary>

Choose an existing profile:

```powershell
node tools/enable-profile.mjs --profile my-profile
```

Choose a DSH data directory that already contains the corresponding `profiles/<name>/package.json`:

dsh-task-groups README · 🚀 Install：```powershell
node tools/enable-profile.mjs --home "D:\DSH" --profile desktop
```

Without `--home`, the installer uses `DSH_HOME` if set, otherwise `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh`.

To uninstall from the default profile, run this command and restart DSH:

```powershell
node tools/enable-profile.mjs --remove
```

If you installed with `--home` or `--profile`, use the same arguments when uninstalling. Uninstalling removes the plugin configuration and directory link, while keeping saved group data.

dsh-task-groups README · 🧭 Usage：| Action | How |
| --- | --- |
| Create a group | Right-click a group → New group, or use the top `⋯` menu |
| Switch views | Click “Groups / Projects” (分组 / 项目) |
| Rename or recolor a group | Click its colored `#` icon |
| Start a task in a group | Click the group’s `⊕` button |
| Reorder or move tasks | Drag a task or group and follow the insertion line |
| Check activity | Click the bell; click again to go back |
| Clear the activity list | Click the broom in the activity panel |
| Search tasks | Top `⋯` → Search tasks (搜索任务) |
| More task actions | Right-click to rename, pin, mark unread, branch, move to a group or archive |
dsh-task-groups README · 🧭 Usage：Deleting a group removes its assignments and keeps its tasks. Right-click a group to edit it, mark all its conversations as read, or archive them in bulk.

dsh-task-groups README · 🛠️ Development and data：Groups, task assignments, ordering and view preferences are saved to `$DSH_HOME/task-groups/state.json`, or `.dsh` under your home directory when `DSH_HOME` is unset. The Host validates and writes state atomically so it survives restarts.

<details>
<summary>Run checks</summary>

Host state persistence and validation:

```powershell

```

dsh-task-groups README · 🛠️ Development and data：UI checks need a development environment with `react`, `react-dom` and `jsdom` installed. Point `DSH_DEV_CHECKOUT` to that environment’s `package.json`:

```powershell
$env:DSH_DEV_CHECKOUT = "D:\path\to\dev-project\package.json"
npm test
```

Covers groups, drag and drop, project view, activity and menus.

</details>
